parameters.name: OperationAll
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to handle all alerts. Valid values:
- **1**: yes
- **0**: no.

parameters.name: OperationCode
parameters.description:
The method to handle the alert event. Valid values:

- **default**: deep scan and removal
- **ignore**: ignore
- **advance\_mark\_mis_info**: add to whitelist
- **manual_handled**: manually handled.

parameters.name: OperationRange
parameters.description: The scope of the handling operation.
